info.title: Test Studio API
info.description: Single-server internal BA/QA workspace. Same-origin writes only. Requests are limited to 10 MB. Local loopback mode may disable authentication; team bindings require a workspace key. Case/module updates use optimistic versions. Settings accepts named HTTP(S) origins and encrypted application login credentials. Run requests reference configured profiles. Profiles are shared within the workspace. No endpoint accepts shell commands or arbitrary runner paths.

PDF is available only for finalized test runs, includes all selected case statuses and detailed findings/evidence, and separates assertion failures from assumptions and execution issues. post.summary: Create or update an application login profile
post.description: Password is write-only and encrypted. Blank preserves it only for an existing profile on the same origin, including the default server-configured login. Saves invalidate the session and reject edits while that profile has queued/running jobs. Current login adapter supports Augastam only.

url.description: HTTP(S) origin without path, query, fragment or URL credentials

version.description: 0 for new or server configured profiles; current version for edits

409.description: Stale version or active jobs

action.description: Must be an action advertised by the connected adapter. Registration also supports workflow: input.workflow must be a key from qa/modules/registration/workflows.json and expected.outcome must be verified. Workflows manage their own variant/data, reject base and registrationType, and accept workflow and approved optional email/peer inputs. Saved-record workflows require target; blank-form workflows reject target. Separate field/toast checks are rejected for workflow actions. Registration unavailable is restricted to reviewed workbook blockers, executes no application assertions and returns BLOCKED with verificationPerformed=false.

outcome.description: Must be an outcome advertised by the adapter.

version.description: Required for updates. A stale or missing version returns 409.

sourceWorkbook.description: Reviewed source workbook provenance; original procedure and execution contract are locked.

automationReadiness.description: Ready means an executor exists, not that live verification passed.

automationBlocker.description: Registered missing-automation reason; not an application defect or a passing check.

executionAdaptation.description: Reviewed adaptation of a source UI action to the current build, preserving the business expectation. Included in the UI, report and exports.

automatedCount.description: Enabled executable definitions only; excludes unavailable and disabled automation.

blockedAutomationCount.description: Definitions without an implemented automatic workflow; not counted as executable.

supported.description: False identifies an automation integration that is still pending.

verificationPerformed.description: False when blocked before application verification. No screenshot is expected.

status.description: Blocked means at least one selected case has no completed automation and no failures/errors take precedence; it is not a pass.

RunSummary.description: List/create responses omit cases and reduce module to id, name and area. total is the snapshotted case count.

data.description: JSON: array of cases or {cases:[...]}. XLSX: base64-encoded workbook. New IDs only; shared bases are not overwritten.
Base64 PNG, up to 4 MB; dimensions are checked.
